expectations.buyer: University core facilities, biotech and materials R&D teams, and specialized analytical labs
expectations.pain: Scientific samples face fragmented facility discovery, protocol qualification, booking, contracting, shipping, chain-of-custody, and result normalization
expectations.strongestIncumbent: Local core-facility portals, institutional research infrastructures, commercial CRO laboratories, equipment networks, and manual expert referrals
expectations.biggestRisk: Public facility catalogues and existing CRO/core networks may absorb discovery while heterogeneous protocols, liability, IP, and sample logistics prevent an automated cross-lab marketplace
